text:
maria_s: Heads-up — GalaxyEdge requested a limited hardware preview on their new Edge A100 board. NDA is signed but legal asked for a quick ops/runbook outline. They want benchmark access + a marketplace tile. Need ops + eng-ml + sales alignment.

derek_r: Got it. Do we have acceptance criteria from them? latency / throughput targets?

amy_k: We asked for their target workloads. Recommend we run three baseline suites: chat-64, embeddings-64, and batched inference (128). Quantization matrix will be provided by eng-ml. Can spin dev cluster for this.

leo_w: Will need the container images and kernel flags for the board. @eng-ml can we reuse the AMP bench harness or do we need custom kernels? Batch-size sweep will be important.

partners-bot: NDA notice: GalaxyEdge NDA expires 2025-05-12. Share artifacts only via partner portal workspace.

sales_eng: Marketing note — they want a coordinated comms plan. Proposed embargo: 2 weeks after partner sign-off on benchmarks. Marketplace tile needs screenshots + approved copy.

maria_s: Proposed schedule: run benchmarks Wed (Mar 26), internal review Thu, partner review Fri, embargo lifts Tue Apr 1. Does that work for everyone?

derek_r: Works for me. Who will own the partner-facing runbook and validation checklist?

amy_k: I'll own the runbook and collect bench logs. I'll push artifacts to s3://redwood-partners/galaxyedge/edge-a100-preview and add a short README with repro steps.

leo_w: We also need the SI onboarding checklist — GalaxyEdge mentioned OrionSI as their integrator. Can someone pull the compliance + network checklist (ports, KMS flow)?

maria_s: I'll loop in Legal for any NDA redlines and PM for joint communications. @sales_eng please create an initial marketplace PR draft and we can iterate.

sales_eng: :thumbsup: Starting the draft now. Also need to confirm pricing model for Dedicated seats if we plan to show sample pricing in the tile.

partners-bot: Deploybot: bench-run job #4512 queued on ci-infra (ETA ~40m).

amy_k: Starting data collection now. Using synthetic prompt set per legal guidance (no customer PII). Will post preliminary graphs when done.

derek_r: If we see tail latency > our SLO, add a fallback in the demo flow to a smaller model variant and note it in the runbook.

maria_s: Excellent. I'll run a quick ops sync at 12:30 to align owners. Invite sent.
